moves.name: Nuzzle
moves.description:
Electric (Physical)
Base Power: 20
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description:
Fairy (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
No additional effect.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description:
Electric (Special)
Base Power: 55
Accuracy: 95
Priority: 0
Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

moves.name: Entrainment
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description:
Electric (Special)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Deals damage to the target equal to (target's current HP - user's current HP). The target is unaffected if its current HP is less than or equal to the user's current HP.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 5
The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.

moves.name: Parabolic Charge
moves.description:
Electric (Special)
Base Power: 65
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: Kebia Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Poison-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Shuca Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Ground-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Lum Berry
items.description: Holder cures itself if it has a non-volatile status or is confused. Single use.

items.name: White Herb
items.description: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.

items.name: Quick Claw
items.description: Each turn, holder has a 20% chance to move first in its priority bracket.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

abilities.name: Cheek Pouch
abilities.description: If this Pokemon eats a held Berry, it restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, in addition to the Berry's effect. This effect can also activate after the effects of Bug Bite, Fling, Pluck, Stuff Cheeks, and Teatime if the eaten Berry had an effect on this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Plus
abilities.description: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.description: At the end of each turn, if this Pokemon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and this Pokemon obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.
